# UNITS ALLOWED

LOFT APARTMENTS (SDC 2.14.1000) • Defined as a dwelling unit on the second story above a light industrial or commercial use • Separate ingress/egress provided for loft apartments • Maximum of 4 loft apartments per lot

LIVE/WORK (SDC 2.14.1000)

• Maximum of 4 consecutively attached work/live townhomes • Residential units limited to second floor • The number of units shall be deducted from the allowable loft units in Section 2.14.1000

ACCESSIBILITY (OSSC 1107) •OSSC 1107.6.2.2.2 Type B Units: Where there are four or more dwelling units or sleeping units intended to be occupied as a residence in a single structure, every dwelling unit and sleeping unit as a residence shall be a Type B unit (Type B units require an accessible entrance) •OSSC 1107.7.1 Structures without Elevator Service: Where elevator service is not provided in a structure, only the dwelling units and sleeping units that are located on stories indicated in Section 1107.7.1.1 are required to be Type B units •OSSC 1107.7.1.1 One Story with Type B Units Required: At least one story containing dwelling units or sleeping units intended to be occupied as a residence shall be provided with an accessible entrance from the exterior of the structure •OSSC 1104.4.1 Mezzanines: An accessible route is not required to stores, mezzanines, and occupied roofs that have an aggregate area of not more than 3,000 SF and are located above and below accessible levels

SUMMARY • Total Dwelling Units Allowed on Site: 4 • 3 dwelling units per building without elevator service • Mezzanines <3.000 SF do not require elevator service
